meta.status: DRAFT – general guidance. Verify every entry against the sources below (Phase 7) before public launch.
meta.disclaimer_en: This is AI-assisted general guidance, not a final diagnosis. Before spraying any chemical, confirm with your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or agriculture officer and always follow the dose written on the product label.
meta.disclaimer_hi: यह AI द्वारा दी गई सामान्य सलाह है, अंतिम निदान नहीं। कोई भी दवा छिड़कने से पहले अपने नज़दीकी कृषि विज्ञान केंद्र (KVK) या कृषि अधिकारी से पुष्टि करें और हमेशा दवा के लेबल पर लिखी मात्रा ही उपयोग करें।
sources_to_verify: ICAR – Indian Council of Agricultural Research (icar.org.in) and its crop institutes
CIB&RC – list of pesticides registered in India (ppqs.gov.in)

healthy_template.cause: No disease signs were detected on this leaf.
symptoms: Even green colour
No spots, powder, curling or rotting
organic: Keep monitoring the field every 3–4 days
Use well-decomposed compost / FYM for strong plants
chemical: No spray needed. Avoid unnecessary pesticide use – it costs money and harms friendly insects.
prevention: Use certified healthy seed or planting material
Avoid water-logging; prefer drip or furrow irrigation
healthy_template.summary_hi: आपकी फसल की पत्ती स्वस्थ दिख रही है। खेत की नियमित निगरानी करते रहें और बिना ज़रूरत दवा का छिड़काव न करें।

Apple___Apple_scab.cause: Fungus Venturia inaequalis. It survives in fallen leaves and spreads in cool, wet weather.
symptoms: Olive-green to black velvety spots on leaves
Leaves may curl, yellow and drop early
Dark cracked scabs on fruit
organic: Collect and destroy fallen leaves after harvest
Prune to open the canopy for air and sunlight
Sulphur-based sprays allowed in organic farming, as per label
chemical: Protective fungicides such as captan or mancozeb
Systemic fungicides such as myclobutanil or difenoconazole when infection is active
prevention: Spray protectively at bud break in rainy springs
Urea spray on fallen leaves in autumn speeds their decay (ask KVK)
Apple___Apple_scab.summary_hi: यह फफूंद से होने वाला रोग है जिसमें पत्तियों और फलों पर काले-जैतूनी धब्बे बनते हैं। गिरी हुई पत्तियाँ नष्ट करें और समय पर फफूंदनाशक का छिड़काव करें।

Apple___Black_rot.cause: Fungus Botryosphaeria obtusa. It lives in dead wood, cankers and dried (mummified) fruit.
symptoms: Purple spots on leaves that turn brown in the centre ('frog-eye')
Sunken cankers on branches
Rotting fruit that turns black and shrivels
organic: Cut out dead branches and cankers, burn or bury them
Remove mummified fruit from the tree and ground
Copper fungicides allowed in organic farming, as per label
chemical: Captan or thiophanate-methyl based fungicides during the season
prevention: Avoid wounds on bark and fruit
Keep orchard clean of dead wood
Balanced nutrition to keep trees vigorous
Apple___Black_rot.summary_hi: यह फफूंद रोग है जिसमें पत्तियों पर 'मेंढक-आंख' जैसे धब्बे और फल काले होकर सड़ते हैं। सूखी डालियाँ और सड़े फल हटाकर नष्ट करें।

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.cause: Fungus Gymnosporangium juniperi-virginianae. It needs juniper/cedar trees nearby to complete its life cycle.
symptoms: Bright yellow-orange spots on upper leaf surface
Small tube-like growths under the spots
Early leaf drop in heavy infection
organic: Remove nearby juniper/cedar host plants if possible
Sulphur sprays as per label
chemical: Myclobutanil or mancozeb from pink-bud stage in wet springs
prevention: Keep 1–2 km away from juniper plantings where possible
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.summary_hi: इसमें पत्तियों पर चमकीले पीले-नारंगी धब्बे बनते हैं। आसपास के जुनिपर (देवदार जैसे) पौधे इस रोग को फैलाते हैं।

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.cause: Fungus Podosphaera clandestina. Favoured by warm days, cool nights and high humidity.
symptoms: White powdery patches on young leaves
Leaves curl upward and become distorted
Shoot growth slows
organic: Prune for good air flow
Wettable sulphur or potassium bicarbonate sprays, as per label
Remove badly infected shoots
chemical: Systemic fungicides such as myclobutanil or hexaconazole
prevention: Do not wet leaves while irrigating
Start sprays at first sign of white powder
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.summary_hi: पत्तियों पर सफ़ेद पाउडर जैसा फफूंद दिखता है। हवा का आवागमन बढ़ाएँ और सल्फर जैसे फफूंदनाशक का लेबल के अनुसार छिड़काव करें।

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.name_hi: मक्का का धूसर पत्ती धब्बा रोग
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.cause: Fungus Cercospora zeae-maydis. It survives on crop residue and spreads in warm, humid, cloudy weather.
symptoms: Long, narrow, rectangular grey-tan spots between leaf veins
Spots join and whole leaves dry
Yield loss if upper leaves are affected before grain filling
organic: Deep ploughing to bury infected residue
Crop rotation with non-cereal crops
Trichoderma-enriched compost in soil
chemical: Strobilurin or triazole fungicides such as azoxystrobin or propiconazole at early disease stage
prevention: Avoid continuous maize in the same field
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.summary_hi: मक्का की पत्तियों पर नसों के बीच लंबे, आयताकार धूसर धब्बे बनते हैं। फसल चक्र अपनाएँ और फसल अवशेष को गहरा दबाएँ।

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.cause: Fungus Puccinia sorghi. Spores travel long distances by wind; cool, moist weather favours it.
symptoms: Small, raised, cinnamon-brown powdery pustules on both leaf surfaces
Leaves yellow and dry in severe cases
organic: Remove volunteer maize plants and weeds
Balanced fertiliser (avoid excess nitrogen)
chemical: Mancozeb or propiconazole when pustules first appear
prevention: Timely sowing as advised for your region
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.summary_hi: पत्तियों पर भूरे-लाल रंग के उभरे हुए पाउडर जैसे दाने बनते हैं। रोगरोधी किस्में बोएँ और शुरुआत में ही उपचार करें।

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.name_hi: मक्का का उत्तरी पत्ती झुलसा (टर्सिकम ब्लाइट)
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.cause: Fungus Exserohilum turcicum. Survives on residue; spreads in moderate temperatures with heavy dew.
symptoms: Long cigar-shaped grey-green to tan lesions (2–15 cm)
Lesions start on lower leaves and move up
Leaves look burnt in severe attack
organic: Remove and destroy infected lower leaves early
Crop rotation and residue management
Seed treatment with Trichoderma
chemical: Mancozeb, propiconazole or azoxystrobin at first lesions
prevention: Do not leave infected residue on the surface
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.summary_hi: पत्तियों पर सिगार जैसे लंबे भूरे-धूसर धब्बे बनते हैं जो नीचे की पत्तियों से ऊपर बढ़ते हैं। समय पर फफूंदनाशक और फसल चक्र अपनाएँ।

Grape___Black_rot.cause: Fungus Guignardia bidwellii. Survives in mummified berries; spreads in warm, wet weather.
symptoms: Round reddish-brown spots with dark borders on leaves
Berries turn brown, then black, hard and shrivelled (mummies)
organic: Remove mummified berries and infected leaves
Prune for air flow
Copper or sulphur sprays allowed in organic farming, as per label
chemical: Mancozeb or myclobutanil from early shoot growth to berry set
prevention: Train vines to avoid dense canopy
Grape___Black_rot.summary_hi: पत्तियों पर लाल-भूरे धब्बे और दाने काले होकर सूख जाते हैं। सूखे दाने हटाएँ और बारिश से पहले बचाव का छिड़काव करें।

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).cause: A complex of wood-decaying fungi (e.g. Phaeomoniella chlamydospora) entering through pruning wounds.
symptoms: 'Tiger-stripe' pattern: yellow/red bands between veins that dry out
Small dark spots on berries
Sudden wilting of the vine in summer
organic: Prune in dry weather and protect large cuts with a wound sealant
Remove and burn badly infected wood
chemical: There is no curative spray. Ask KVK about registered pruning-wound protectants.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).summary_hi: यह लकड़ी के अंदर फैलने वाला फफूंद रोग है, पत्तियों पर बाघ जैसी धारियाँ बनती हैं। इसका कोई सीधा इलाज नहीं है, छंटाई के घाव सुरक्षित रखें।

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.name_hi: अंगूर का पत्ती झुलसा (आइसैरियोप्सिस पत्ती धब्बा)
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.cause: Fungus Pseudocercospora vitis. Common in humid conditions late in the season.
symptoms: Irregular dark brown spots on older leaves
Spots merge, leaves dry and drop early
organic: Remove infected leaves
Improve air flow by canopy management
Copper sprays as per label
chemical: Mancozeb or copper oxychloride
prevention: Keep vineyard free of fallen leaves
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.summary_hi: पुरानी पत्तियों पर गहरे भूरे अनियमित धब्बे बनते हैं और पत्तियाँ जल्दी गिरती हैं। संक्रमित पत्तियाँ हटाएँ।

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).name_hi: नींबू वर्गीय पौधों का ग्रीनिंग रोग (हुआंगलोंगबिंग)
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).cause: Bacterium 'Candidatus Liberibacter asiaticus', spread by the Asian citrus psyllid insect and infected grafts.
symptoms: Blotchy, uneven yellowing of leaves (not matching on both halves)
Small, lopsided, bitter fruit that stays green
Twig dieback and tree decline
organic: Remove and destroy infected trees to protect others
Neem-based sprays and yellow sticky traps to reduce psyllids
chemical: No cure for the bacterium. Control the psyllid vector with insecticides such as imidacloprid or thiamethoxam, only as advised by experts.
prevention: Plant only certified disease-free nursery plants
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).summary_hi: यह जीवाणु रोग सिट्रस सिल्लिड कीट से फैलता है, पत्तियाँ असमान पीली पड़ती हैं। इसका इलाज नहीं है, संक्रमित पेड़ हटाएँ और कीट नियंत्रित करें।

Peach___Bacterial_spot.cause: Bacterium Xanthomonas arboricola pv. pruni. Spreads by rain splash and wind, especially on sandy soils.
symptoms: Small angular purple-brown spots on leaves
Spot centres fall out leaving 'shot holes'
Cracked, pitted spots on fruit
organic: Prune infected twigs in dry weather
Avoid overhead irrigation
chemical: Copper-based bactericides labelled for peach (peach leaves are sensitive – follow label strictly)
Peach___Bacterial_spot.summary_hi: पत्तियों पर छोटे बैंगनी-भूरे धब्बे बनते हैं जो बाद में छेद बन जाते हैं। संक्रमित टहनियाँ काटें और लेबल के अनुसार कॉपर दवा का प्रयोग करें।

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.name_hi: शिमला मिर्च का जीवाणु धब्बा रोग
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.cause: Bacteria Xanthomonas species. Carried on seed and spread by rain splash, tools and hands.
symptoms: Small water-soaked spots that turn brown with yellow halo
Leaves yellow and drop
Raised scabby spots on fruit
organic: Remove infected plants and leaves
Hot-water seed treatment before sowing (ask KVK for method)
Do not work in the field when plants are wet
chemical: Copper oxychloride or copper hydroxide, often combined with mancozeb
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.summary_hi: पत्तियों पर पीले घेरे वाले भूरे धब्बे बनते हैं और पत्तियाँ गिरती हैं। स्वस्थ बीज लें, संक्रमित पौधे हटाएँ और कॉपर दवा का प्रयोग करें।

Potato___Early_blight.cause: Fungus Alternaria solani. Survives in soil and residue; attacks weak or older leaves in warm weather.
symptoms: Dark brown spots with rings like a target ('bull's-eye') on older leaves
Yellowing around spots
Leaves dry from the bottom upward
organic: Remove infected lower leaves
Spray neem-based products or Trichoderma/Pseudomonas bio-formulations, as per label
Adequate potash and nitrogen to keep plants strong
chemical: Mancozeb, chlorothalonil or azoxystrobin at first symptoms
Potato___Early_blight.summary_hi: पुरानी पत्तियों पर गोल छल्लों वाले भूरे धब्बे बनते हैं। नीचे की संक्रमित पत्तियाँ हटाएँ और शुरुआत में ही फफूंदनाशक का छिड़काव करें।

Potato___Late_blight.cause: Phytophthora infestans. Spreads extremely fast in cool (10–20 °C), cloudy, foggy and wet weather.
symptoms: Water-soaked pale to dark brown patches on leaf tips and edges
White mould under leaves in the morning
Whole field can collapse within days; tubers rot
organic: Remove and destroy infected plants immediately (do not leave in field)
Earth up soil around plants to protect tubers
Copper sprays allowed in organic farming, as per label
chemical: Preventive: mancozeb before disease appears when weather is cool and foggy
Curative: cymoxanil + mancozeb, metalaxyl-M + mancozeb or dimethomorph combinations – as advised by KVK
prevention: Destroy cull piles and volunteer potatoes
Potato___Late_blight.summary_hi: यह बहुत तेज़ फैलने वाला रोग है, ठंडे और कोहरे वाले मौसम में पत्तियाँ काली-भूरी होकर झुलस जाती हैं। तुरंत संक्रमित पौधे हटाएँ और KVK की सलाह से दवा छिड़कें।

Squash___Powdery_mildew.name_hi: कद्दू वर्गीय फसलों का चूर्णिल आसिता (पाउडरी मिल्ड्यू)
Squash___Powdery_mildew.cause: Fungi Podosphaera xanthii / Erysiphe cichoracearum. Favoured by dry days, humid nights and shade.
symptoms: White powdery spots on upper leaf surface that spread to cover the leaf
Leaves yellow and dry
Smaller fruits
organic: Spray wettable sulphur, potassium bicarbonate, or diluted milk solution (research-backed home remedy)
Remove badly infected leaves
chemical: Hexaconazole, myclobutanil or similar systemic fungicides, as per label
prevention: Start control at the first white spots
Squash___Powdery_mildew.summary_hi: पत्तियों के ऊपर सफ़ेद पाउडर जैसी परत बनती है। सल्फर या पोटैशियम बाइकार्बोनेट का छिड़काव करें और ज़्यादा संक्रमित पत्तियाँ हटाएँ।

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.cause: Fungus Diplocarpon earlianum. Survives on old leaves; spreads by water splash.
symptoms: Many small dark purple spots on leaves
Spots join, leaf looks burnt/scorched and dries
organic: Remove and destroy old infected leaves after harvest
Use mulch to reduce soil splash
Copper sprays as per label
chemical: Captan or copper-based fungicides
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.summary_hi: पत्तियों पर बहुत से छोटे बैंगनी धब्बे बनते हैं और पत्ती जली हुई दिखती है। पुरानी पत्तियाँ हटाएँ और मल्चिंग करें।

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.cause: Bacteria Xanthomonas species. Seed-borne; spreads by rain splash, overhead watering and handling wet plants.
symptoms: Small dark, greasy-looking spots on leaves, often with yellow halo
Leaf edges and tips dry
Raised, scabby spots on fruit
organic: Remove infected leaves and plants
Hot-water seed treatment (ask KVK for method)
Avoid working in the field when leaves are wet
chemical: Copper oxychloride or copper hydroxide, often mixed with mancozeb
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.summary_hi: पत्तियों पर छोटे काले चिकने धब्बे बनते हैं जिनके चारों ओर पीला घेरा होता है। स्वस्थ बीज लें और कॉपर दवा का प्रयोग करें।

Tomato___Early_blight.cause: Fungus Alternaria solani. Survives in soil and plant debris; worse in warm, humid weather and on stressed plants.
symptoms: Brown spots with concentric rings ('target' look) on older leaves
Yellowing around spots, lower leaves drop
Dark sunken spots near fruit stem
organic: Remove lower infected leaves
Mulch to stop soil splashing onto leaves
Trichoderma or Pseudomonas fluorescens bio-formulations, as per label
chemical: Mancozeb, chlorothalonil, azoxystrobin or difenoconazole at first symptoms
prevention: Staking and pruning for air flow
Tomato___Early_blight.summary_hi: पुरानी पत्तियों पर गोल छल्लों वाले भूरे धब्बे बनते हैं। नीचे की पत्तियाँ हटाएँ, मल्चिंग करें और समय पर दवा छिड़कें।

Tomato___Late_blight.cause: Phytophthora infestans. Spreads very fast in cool, wet, foggy weather.
symptoms: Large, irregular, greasy grey-green to brown patches on leaves
White fuzzy growth under leaves in humid mornings
Firm brown rot on fruit
organic: Remove and destroy infected plants immediately
Avoid overhead watering
Copper sprays allowed in organic farming, as per label
chemical: Preventive: mancozeb in cool, foggy weather
Curative: cymoxanil + mancozeb, metalaxyl-M + mancozeb or dimethomorph combinations – as advised by KVK
prevention: Do not grow next to potato fields
Tomato___Late_blight.summary_hi: ठंडे और नमी वाले मौसम में पत्तियों पर बड़े भूरे-काले धब्बे बनते हैं और रोग तेज़ी से फैलता है। संक्रमित पौधे तुरंत हटाएँ और KVK की सलाह लें।

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.cause: Fungus Passalora fulva (Fulvia fulva). Very common in polyhouses with high humidity (>85%).
symptoms: Pale yellow spots on upper leaf surface
Olive-green to brown velvety mould under the leaf
Leaves curl and dry
organic: Increase ventilation in polyhouse
Remove lower infected leaves
Avoid wetting leaves
chemical: Chlorothalonil, mancozeb or copper-based fungicides
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.summary_hi: पत्ती के ऊपर पीले धब्बे और नीचे भूरी मखमली फफूंद दिखती है। पॉलीहाउस में हवा का आवागमन बढ़ाएँ और नमी कम रखें।

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.name_hi: टमाटर का सेप्टोरिया पत्ती धब्बा रोग
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.cause: Fungus Septoria lycopersici. Survives on debris and weeds; spreads by water splash.
symptoms: Many small round spots with dark border and grey-white centre
Tiny black dots in spot centres
Lower leaves yellow and fall
organic: Remove infected lower leaves
Mulch and drip irrigation
Copper sprays as per label
chemical: Chlorothalonil or mancozeb
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.summary_hi: पत्तियों पर बहुत सारे छोटे गोल धब्बे बनते हैं जिनका बीच का भाग धूसर-सफ़ेद होता है। नीचे की पत्तियाँ हटाएँ और मल्चिंग करें।

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.cause: Tiny mite Tetranychus urticae. Multiplies fast in hot, dry, dusty conditions.
symptoms: Fine yellow-white speckles (stippling) on leaves
Fine webbing under leaves
Leaves turn bronze and dry
organic: Spray plain water forcefully under leaves
Neem oil (azadirachtin) sprays, as per label
Conserve predatory mites and lady beetles
chemical: Acaricides such as abamectin, spiromesifen or fenpyroximate; wettable sulphur also controls mites
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.summary_hi: बहुत छोटे माइट पत्तियों का रस चूसते हैं जिससे पत्तियों पर सफ़ेद-पीले बिंदु और जाले बनते हैं। पत्तियों के नीचे पानी की तेज़ धार और नीम तेल का छिड़काव करें।

Tomato___Target_Spot.cause: Fungus Corynespora cassiicola. Favoured by warm, humid weather and dense canopy.
symptoms: Brown spots with light centre and rings, on leaves and fruit
Spots merge and leaves drop
organic: Prune lower leaves and improve air flow
Remove crop debris
chemical: Chlorothalonil, mancozeb or azoxystrobin
Tomato___Target_Spot.summary_hi: पत्तियों और फलों पर छल्लों वाले भूरे धब्बे बनते हैं। हवा का आवागमन बढ़ाएँ और फसल अवशेष नष्ट करें।

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.name_hi: टमाटर का पीला पत्ती मोड़क विषाणु रोग
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.cause: Virus spread by whitefly (Bemisia tabaci). Infected plants cannot be cured.
symptoms: Small leaves curled upward with yellow edges
Stunted, bushy plants
Very few flowers and fruits
organic: Uproot and destroy infected plants early
Yellow sticky traps to catch whiteflies
Neem oil sprays to reduce whiteflies
Raise nursery under insect-proof net
chemical: No medicine cures the virus. Control whiteflies with insecticides such as imidacloprid, thiamethoxam or pyriproxyfen, only as advised by KVK.
prevention: Barrier crops such as maize around the field
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.summary_hi: यह विषाणु रोग सफ़ेद मक्खी से फैलता है, पत्तियाँ छोटी, पीली और ऊपर की ओर मुड़ जाती हैं। इसका इलाज नहीं है, संक्रमित पौधे उखाड़ें और सफ़ेद मक्खी नियंत्रित करें।

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.cause: Very stable virus spread by touch, tools, infected seed and tobacco products.
symptoms: Light and dark green mosaic pattern on leaves
Leaves wrinkled, narrow or fern-like
Uneven ripening of fruit
organic: Uproot and destroy infected plants
Wash hands with soap before handling plants; do not smoke/chew tobacco in the field
Disinfect tools
chemical: No chemical can cure a virus. Focus on removal and hygiene.
prevention: Remove infected plants early to stop spread
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.summary_hi: पत्तियों पर हल्के और गहरे हरे रंग का चितकबरा (मोज़ेक) पैटर्न बनता है। इसका इलाज नहीं है, संक्रमित पौधे हटाएँ और औज़ार व हाथ साफ़ रखें।
